title: When Reflecting on Your Past: - Write It Down: Keep a Journal of Key
description: When reflecting on your past: - Write it down: Keep a journal of key events and your thoughts at the time. - Ask others: Check your memories against those who were present. - Stay objective: Remind yourself that people change, and it’s okay if your past views differ from the present. Example: If you recall always loving your current career, check past entries or conversations to see if you had doubts.
